integrity: Proof and finite numerical consistency checks using distinct computational methods are contained in the embedded files. All results are preliminary and are not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact near-zero formula for compact boundaryless flat cone surfaces with isolated cone angles in (0,2pi). The finite orbifold signature classification assumes orientable reflector-free compact Euclidean 2-orbifolds. Does not recover locations, full metric, boundary or mirror types, or cone angles greater than 2pi. Earlier orbifold volume-comparison dissertation not fully accessible; historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact small-distance law on flat cone surfaces and Euclidean orbifold signature recovery
